commit 8b9e2bc010e8f0c9733ff88ec05b043266371f6f
Author:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon May 25 08:41:20 2026 +0300
Commit:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon May 25 08:41:20 2026 +0300

    Bug 2034245 - Cleanup Thunderbird Source Package r=dandarnell
    
    
    These targets were removed from toolkit, where comm/main/installer inhereted them
    Source packaging is now done through a mach command, though `make upload` is still used
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D295963

diff --git a/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure b/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
index 8b7839f2e1b..08572e41b46 100644
--- a/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
+++ b/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@ def read_sourcestamp(repository):
                 pass
 
             if len(lines) != 3:
-                log.warn("sourcestamp.txt is corrupt!")
+                log.warning("sourcestamp.txt is corrupt!")
                 return
 
             if lines and lines[line2read].startswith("http"):
diff --git a/mail/build.mk b/mail/build.mk
index ea9196e73e9..907a549ab24 100644
--- a/mail/build.mk
+++ b/mail/build.mk
@@ -17,15 +17,9 @@ stage-package:
 install::
 	@$(MAKE) -C comm/mail/installer install
 
-source-package::
-	@$(MAKE) -C comm/mail/installer source-package
-
 upload::
 	@$(MAKE) -C comm/mail/installer upload
 
-source-upload::
-	@$(MAKE) -C comm/mail/installer source-upload
-
 hg-bundle::
 	@$(MAKE) -C comm/mail/installer hg-bundle
